crossRefs.note: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:

parallels.note: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.
But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
But if I by God’s finger cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come to you.

translations.web: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:
translations.bsb: and to have authority to drive out demons.
translations.kjv: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:
translations.asv: and to have authority to cast out demons:
